tools_used: local PDF text extraction via uvx pypdf
helpful: Provisioned petition.txt: it disclosed that this is a tag-along petition asking for a hold behind No. 25-1383, which reframed the whole forecast.
The sal-v4 band table's bracketed reached rates gave a clean leakage-safe anchor.
supremecourt.gov docket pages fetch cleanly as HTML.
gaps: CourtListener MCP returned zero results for every SCOTUS docket search (26-2, Town of Vinton, Indian Harbor), so companion-petition lookup had to go through web search; a provisioned list of related SCOTUS petitions (same lower-court opinion or same QP) would remove that detour.
fedcourts query has no caption or free-text filter, so it cannot find a named companion petition; scanning 500 open rows by caption found nothing.
WebFetch cannot read PDFs (briefs, order lists); I had to extract text locally with pypdf. A sidecar PDF-to-text for supremecourt.gov documents would help.
The statpack has no response-requested cut, although a call for a response is the strongest pre-conference signal on this docket.
notes: Retrieval ran to roughly 25 calls, at the advisory budget. The corpus priors were not informative for this petition (no topic filter on SCOTUS rows); the base-rate and band tables were.
